The identifier for the reimbursement account. Echos the ReimbursementAccountId passed in the request.
The dollar amount that has been overpaid. This amount is used in the AvailableToSpend calculation.
The dollar amount that has been recouped from overpayments. This amount is used in the AvailableToSpend calculation.

The amount that is available to spend from the reimbursement account.
It is typically calculated as follows: AvailableToSpend = AccountBalance + CarroverAmount - (Overpaid - Recouped).
For LinkedAccounts, this amount could be 0.
This is typically the same as the AvailableCredit, unless the account is deposit based instead of election based.

The dollar amount of the account balance for the reimbursement account that is available for use.
This amount is based off the election amount plus any beginning carryover amounts and already carried over amounts minus card hold amounts, total reimbursed, and fees.
It does not include overpaid amounts or recouped amounts.
The dollar amount that is currently held on the card as pending transactions. These are unsettled transactions that have not yet been processed.
The additional dollar amount available for use that can be carried over from the prior plan year, if applicable.

The identifier for the linked account, if applicable. This is used to identify the linked account associated with the reimbursement account.
Could be the same as the ReimbursementAccountId when this account is the one others are linked to.
The BalanceDetailsDto for the linked accounts associated with this reimbursement account, if applicable.
